baude wrote
AS_Games: You shouldn’t make assumptions if you aren’t completely sure about what you’re saying. I say this with the best of intentions, because, honestly, I’m really looking forward to seeing more of your work.

Ichigo: Why the "LOL"? Lately, it feels like some of the forum veterans—a forum we all love so much and to which they have contributed a great deal—are being overly critical and harsh toward anything that deviates from the usual script. Not everything out there is bad; not everyone has ill intentions; and not every use of AI is a sign of laziness or a waste of time.


Yes, I know what I’m talking about because this is the reality of the present day; many people claim they don’t use AI, but they actually do. I see AI as a tool, just like any other. Without it, I believe that developing an engine from scratch in assembly which is what I’m currently doing would be an incredibly complicated and difficult task. I have great respect for all the veterans; after all, I am still a learner, and I’m very much in the process of growing and developing my skills. This game means a great deal to me it’s a dream coming true.

entry.title: Made By AI :: RE: Warlord new game for Sega Master System!
entry.dc:creator: ichigo
entry.dc:subject: Made By AI
entry.content:
Author: ichigo
Posted: Tue Nov 17, 2026 12:06 pm (GMT 0)

You can do better than this "Bomberman" clone and ports.
There are many things I don't like about them, and obviously, the biggest one is that they are lazy ports/things (or mixes of several existing games).

At least use the power of LLMs to make new things, FROM SCRATCH.
With your own idea/universe.
Not some quick thing ripping music or gfx from existing games — a completely new game.

You'll certainly need to form a group, because gfx (pixel art) and music (PSG) have to be done by humans (LLMs are pretty bad at this; we're dealing with a basic 8-bit machine with heavy constraints, not a Switch or a PC).

At least AS_port showed us something new 👍

baude wrote
ichigo wrote
I'm much less hostile to AI than some of my peers ;)

It can do some really great things, BUT we still have to point out that you need to prompt/steer LLMs very well to get the best out of them (and therefore be technical/know what you're talking about, because AI isn't actually 'magical').

So far, I haven't seen anything extraordinary.


Haven’t you noticed anything extraordinary—whether here on this forum or elsewhere?

In my view, Bomberman S and Megaman II, for instance, are on an extraordinary level. You can clearly see the work, effort, and a solid grasp of what an AI can—and should—be capable of doing.


Yes, those games are fantastic!

Maxim wrote
AI generated content is not development, we have a separate forum for that. Also, many users care deeply about this and we want it to be clear.


Understood, in that case, feel free to move it to the appropriate location or delete it. I used AI to assist with the assembly programming for this game, which is an original, exclusive title for the Master System, I’ve actually been working on it for nearly five months.

As for the use of AI as a development tool, I suspect you’ll need to remove or delete some of the tools created to aid in the development process, since nearly all of them were built with the help of AI.
